import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Recolor the large irregular object, leaving isolated same-color marks intact.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==3 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while st:
          y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); st.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append((col,comp))
    # The primary blob is the largest component of color 6; its target is 0.
    candidates=[comp for col,comp in comps if col==6 and len(comp)>1]
    if candidates:
      comp=max(candidates,key=len)
      for r,c in comp: out[r][c]=0
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
